visual.general_description: Two axial abdominal CT images with yellow dashed arrows pointing at an anterior midline nodule and printed millimetre measurements.
visual.detailed_description: Two side-by-side grayscale axial CT slices of the abdomen on black backgrounds, each with an "R" at the left edge and a tick-mark scale along the right edge. Both show the abdominal wall as a thick ring around bowel loops, with gas-filled bowel and bright (contrast-filled) bowel segments, and a vertebra with the spinal canal at the lower center. In the left image a yellow dashed arrow points down at a rounded, mottled soft-tissue nodule at the anterior midline just inside the abdominal wall; printed measurement text "33.5 mm" sits above-left of the nodule and a second partly obscured measurement label ending in "mm" lies across the nodule. In the right image a yellow dashed arrow points down at the same anterior midline region, where the nodule is not clearly separable from adjacent bowel and mesentery; printed text "13.2 mm" is at the upper left of that region and a second measurement label is too small to read. The lower part of each image shows the curved scanner table. No patient name, date or other identifying text is visible.

visual.general_description: Line chart of CA-125 over years since diagnosis for Case 1 with an orange band marking T-Dxd start to end.
visual.detailed_description: A line chart with black circular data points joined by thin black lines on a white background, titled "CA-125 levels over time: Case 1". The x-axis is labelled "Years since diagnosis" with ticks 0 to 5; the y-axis is labelled "CA-125" with ticks 0, 50, 100, 150, 200. A legend at the upper left lists two orange dashed-line entries "T-Dxd start" and "T-Dxd end". Two vertical orange dashed lines at about 3.1 and 4.1 years enclose a light-orange shaded band. The curve starts near 44 at 0, drops to below 10 within the first half year, stays near 5 to 10 until about 1 year, then rises to a peak near 135 at about 1.3 years, falls to about 20, rises again to a peak near 93 at about 2 years, and falls to under 10 by about 2.3 years. It rises with fluctuation to roughly 130 to 138 near 2.7 to 2.8 years and a highest point near 234 at about 2.9 years, dips to about 65 to 70, and rises to about 177 just at the left edge of the shaded band. Inside the band the values fall to about 57, then to roughly 13 and stay in a low band near 8 to 14. After the band ends at about 4.1 years the values rise gradually from about 10 to about 39 at about 4.8 years.

visual.general_description: Fused PET/CT grid: presacral area (top row) and liver lesion (bottom row) at 1 month before, 5 months and 15 months of T-DXd, with arrows at the lesions.
visual.detailed_description: A 2 by 3 grid of axial fused PET/CT slices (grayscale CT with a red-orange-yellow uptake overlay) on black backgrounds. Column headings above read "1 month prior to initiating T-DXd", "After 5 months of T-DXd treatment" and "After 15 months of T-DXd treatment"; row labels at the left read "Presacral area" and "Liver lesion". An "R" marker is at the left of each image and the curved scanner table is visible at the bottom. Top row (pelvis): a white dashed arrow in each image points to the presacral region. In the first image there is a bright yellow-orange uptake focus at the arrow, with additional scattered uptake in the central pelvis; in the second it is much fainter red-orange, with a bright central pelvic spot; in the third only faint red-orange uptake is visible at the arrow. Bottom row (upper abdomen): a white dashed arrow in each image points to the anterior right liver edge. The first shows a bright yellow focus at the arrow; the second a smaller, dimmer orange-yellow focus; the third no distinct bright focus at the arrow. The third bottom image also has a separate bright yellow-orange area in the posterior right upper abdomen, at the lower left of the image, that is not marked by an arrow; both posterior upper abdomen regions show red-orange uptake in all three bottom images. Small grey burned-in text beginning "Image Time" followed by digits is at the lower right of several images.
